patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections with dark overlays for text contrast, often featuring cinematic, high-quality photography.
Large, clean sans-serif headings are used for section titles, providing strong visual hierarchy and ample negative space.
A sophisticated palette of dark greys, black, and white dominates, with a distinctive Leica red used sparingly as a brand accent for logos and interactive elements.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls.
Sections are often introduced by a prominent, bold heading, followed by a grid-based layout for products, articles, or events, heavily relying on high-quality imagery.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image is set as a background, with text and interactive elements positioned over it. The background image uses a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content, creating depth as the user scrolls.

The primary navigation bar starts transparent with white text, then transitions to a sticky, opaque dark background with white text and a filled 'Online Store' button as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, drawing attention to new information as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons, input fields, and some image containers, maintaining a refined but not overly soft aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, with tighter spacing in product grids and blog listings.

standout: The site's standout feature is its cinematic visual storytelling, achieved through a combination of high-quality, full-bleed photography and subtle motion. The design effectively conveys a sense of luxury, craftsmanship, and artistic vision, making the products feel aspirational rather than merely functional.
